integrity: All mathematical assertions are about unnormalized Fourier multipliers of equivalence-relation supports; finite checks corroborate, but do not replace, an all-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: No general nonvanishing result for odd-edge frequency graphs at dimensions n congruent to 2 modulo 12.
The theorem does not give all exact integer Walsh coefficients, nor exact inverse norms in each dimension.
The 1979 Bell-period paper full text was not accessible during literature comparison; period modulo eight has an independent proof here.
Historical originality remains conditional on inaccessible or unidentified broader signed graph-partition literature.
title: Exact dyadic Walsh valuations for equivalence-relation supports
